app.title: CRNS Data Hub (Streamlit)
app.summary: A person chooses which sensors to work on, a processing configuration and a few run options. They then run the stages of a processing pipeline (sync raw files, merge them per sensor, apply corrections, calibrate, make reports and maps) one at a time or all together, and watch each stage's output stream into a console. A dashboard shows counts, the status of the last run, an embedded performance report and a map of the sensor network. In a data explorer they pick a merged or processed dataset, see summary statistics, plot chosen columns over a date range, select a stretch with a box or lasso, and export that selection or the filtered data as CSV, or the plot as HTML or PNG. Each component's log can be filtered and downloaded.

task.text: Run and monitor a pipeline that turns a sensor network's raw records into merged, corrected and calibrated time series, then inspect and export them.

data.text: Raw logger files from many field sensors, harmonized into one time-series table per sensor and split into deployment phases, plus sensor location metadata and pipeline run logs.
data.item: one sensor's merged time series of neutron counts and weather readings, tagged by deployment phase

stage.text: harmonizing and processing field sensor records as they arrive, and keeping the sensor network in order, before analysis

mechanism.text: A sidebar switches between four pages that share the selected sensors. Pipeline steps run as subprocesses and stream their output into a console. Dashboard metrics, the performance report and the network map are regenerated from the same pipeline. In the explorer, a configurable chart filtered by date feeds a box or lasso selection that becomes a CSV export.

field.text: cosmic-ray neutron sensing of soil moisture across a sensor network, in earth science

workflow.name: run a processing pipeline over many instruments' records and export the processed series

steps.step: choose which items to process and with what settings
steps.here: pick sensors or 'All sensors', a process config YAML, and toggles for field/SD sync, forced re-sync and phase-by-phase processing

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: run sync, merge, correction and soil-moisture processing, N0 calibration from field samples, reports and maps, one at a time or as a full run, and watch each one's live console output and exit status

steps.step: filter to the items that matter
steps.here: a custom merge groups sensors by a metadata property, then limits the result to a timeframe and chosen columns, optionally adding a counts-per-hour column from detected count and integration-time pairs

steps.step: look over every item at a glance
steps.here: metric cards for sensors, merged and processed files, and last run status, a table of steps from the last run, an embedded performance report and a sensor network map

choose a merged or processed dataset to see rows, columns, date range, a preview and per-column statistics, then plot chosen columns against time with a date range filter, an optional secondary axis and a correlation matrix
select points with a box or lasso to export them as a CSV, or download the filtered data as CSV and the plot as HTML or PNG
choose a component log, filter its lines by a search term, and download it

distinctive: Records are split into deployment phases, each with its own parsing config, and N0 is calibrated separately for each phase from soil sample campaigns.
Neutron counts can be normalised to counts per hour by pairing each count column with its integration-time column, which the interface detects automatically.
The interface doesn't compute anything itself: it launches command-line pipeline scripts and streams their terminal output live, keeping the last run for review.
Monitoring products (a performance report and a network map) are made by the pipeline and embedded in the dashboard, which can regenerate them.

parts.title: Navigation and quick stats
parts.summary: Switches between the Dashboard, Pipeline, Data explorer and Logs pages, and shows how many sensors, merged datasets and processed datasets there are.

parts.title: Dashboard
parts.summary: Shows the network's status: key counts, the result of the last pipeline run step by step, an embedded performance report, and a sensor location map with its metadata table, each of which can be regenerated or downloaded.

parts.title: Pipeline runner
parts.summary: Sets the sensors, process config and run flags, then runs sync, merge, processing, calibration, reports, dashboard, map, or the full pipeline, with live streamed terminal output and an exit status.

parts.title: Custom merging
parts.summary: A five-step form that groups sensors by a metadata property, then sets a timeframe, the output location and the columns, optionally adds a counts-per-hour column, and writes merged CSVs.

parts.title: Data explorer
parts.summary: Chooses a merged or processed dataset and shows its rows, columns, file size and date range, a preview table, and descriptive statistics per column.

parts.title: Interactive plots
parts.summary: Plots one or more columns against time or another column as a line, scatter, bar, area, histogram or box chart. It can use a secondary axis and a date range filter, and shows a correlation matrix between the plotted columns.

parts.title: Export
parts.summary: Shows how many rows and what range the box or lasso selection covers, and downloads that selection or the filtered data as CSV, and the plot as HTML or PNG.

parts.title: Pipeline logs
parts.summary: Lists the component log files with the newest first, shows the chosen log with its last-modified time, filters its lines by a search term, and downloads it.
